title: Why You Judge Attractive People Differently
hook: You likely think attractive people are smarter.

narration.text: You likely think attractive people are smarter.
This is called the halo effect, a cognitive bias.
When we see a positive trait, like attractiveness, our brains assume other good qualities.
We unconsciously expect them to also be kinder, funnier, and more intelligent.
This bias affects everything from job interviews to courtrooms.
Being aware of it helps us make fairer judgements.
Comment if you have noticed this bias in action, like this video if it surprised you, and subscribe to understand your mind better.

description: Discover why we tend to rate attractive individuals as more intelligent or kind, a phenomenon known as the halo effect. This cognitive bias can influence our perceptions in many areas of life. Understanding it helps us make more objective judgements.
topic: Why people tend to rate attractive individuals as more intelligent or kind. This is known as the halo effect.
